name: Hydrating Face Cream
description: Light daily moisturizer for soft and smooth skin.
usage: Apply a small amount to clean skin every morning and evening.

name: Vitamin C Serum
description: Brightening serum that helps improve skin tone.
usage: Use 2-3 drops on dry skin before moisturizer once daily.

name: Gentle Cleanser
description: Foaming cleanser that removes dirt and excess oil.
usage: Massage on wet face for 30 seconds then rinse thoroughly.

name: Sunscreen SPF 50
description: Broad-spectrum sunscreen for daily UV protection.
usage: Apply generously 15 minutes before sun exposure and reapply every 2 hours.
